property: RIP and OSPF occupy the interior-routing role while using different algorithmic traditions: distance-vector/Bellman-Ford versus link-state/SPF.

date_or_range.notes: Both protocol families were available during the transition to larger routed IP networks.

sources.supports: OSPF link-state/SPF design and explicit departure from Bellman-Ford-based traditional TCP/IP protocols

negative_claims: This edge explicitly rejects a formal RIP→OSPF revision chain.
It does not claim OSPF source code or packet format descends from RIP.
Operational replacement patterns must be established per network/vendor rather than inferred from standards dates.
open_questions: Collect contemporary migration/operator documents comparing RIP and OSPF.
notes: Useful negative-lineage record: same role does not mean direct ancestry.
